# LilyPond import fixtures

These public-domain Mutopia editions are unmodified. Each accompanying `.notes` file gives the visible written notes from the corresponding LilyPond source. Each line is one measure. Entries encode staff, sounding MIDI pitch, onset within the measure and duration in quarter notes. Repeated entries preserve unisons belonging to different voices. The source transcription was cross-checked against Mutopia’s published MIDI after joining ties and simultaneous unisons.

| Score | Engraver | PDF and source |
| --- | --- | --- |
| BWV 999, single-staff lute/guitar arrangement | Jakob Bagterp | [Letter PDF](https://www.mutopiaproject.org/ftp/BachJS/BWV999/Bach_Prelude_BWV999/Bach_Prelude_BWV999-let.pdf) · [LilyPond](https://www.mutopiaproject.org/ftp/BachJS/BWV999/Bach_Prelude_BWV999/Bach_Prelude_BWV999.ly) |
